gloss: in the middle of work; working; under construction

definitions.gloss: in the middle of work; working; under construction
definitions.explanation: Indicates that work or an operation is currently in progress. Used on signs, in status messages, and in everyday conversation.

examples.japanese: ⟦ただいま→ただいま：01062_tadaima⟧{作業中|さぎょうちゅう}です。
{作業中|さぎょうちゅう}⟦につき→につき：17196_nitsuki⟧⟦{通行止|つうこうど}め→通行止め：19920_tsuukoudome⟧。
examples.english: Road closed due to work in progress.

examples.japanese: ⟦サーバー→サーバー：04755_saabaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{作業中|さぎょうちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦しばらく→しばらく：01267_shibaraku⟧お⟦{待|ま}ち→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: The server is undergoing maintenance, so please wait a moment.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧ ('work, operation, task') and ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ ('during, in the middle of'). Very commonly seen on signs at construction sites, in software status messages, and as a general way to say something is in progress. The suffix ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ can attach to many nouns to indicate an ongoing state.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {作業中|さぎょうちゅう}⟦につき→につき：17196_nitsuki⟧: due to work in progress
- {作業中|さぎょうちゅう}⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧: caution: work in progress
- ⟦ただいま→ただいま：01062_tadaima⟧{作業中|さぎょうちゅう}: currently working

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{工事中|こうじちゅう}→工事中：09625_koujichuu⟧: under construction — specifically for building/road construction
- メンテナンス⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧: under maintenance — common for websites and systems
- ⟦{準備中|じゅんびちゅう}→準備中：09540_junbichuu⟧: in preparation — for shops or events not yet open
